description: Tenda MF6 (ZTE ZX297520V3 Mi-Fi): signal, battery and SMS over its web; a debug mode with AT ports can be switched on from its web and, unlike Huawei's, survives a reboot (bands then by AT+ZLTEBAND): the engine never switches it on (19d2:1557). A router inside the stick: cdc_ether or rndis_host and a DHCP address, no AT port in this composition; signal, operator and SMS over the ZTE goform web API at 192.168.0.1 (Referer and X-Requested-With needed, a session first on newer firmware), the web password in the modem's settings. The model is told by its web (model_name, or the firmware string such as BD_XBKZMF79N...). Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: docs/modem-zoo/modems/zte-mf-family.md (zte-mf6-debug-persistence); another modem manager 3.5.8 README (Tenda MF6 19d2:1557); another modem manager 3.5.8 hilink.sh (goform: Referer, X-Requested-With, session; MF79N firmware string); docs/modem-zoo/modems/zte-mf-family.md; docs/HANDOFF.md 162, 164. Its serial ports are kept from ModemManager (mm_ports control) and the stick stays a router with them: DHCP and the web API, never a ModemManager dial over its debug AT ports (profiles audit 2026-10-19).
